expectation: Membrane stain of vascular endothelium and CD34+ stromal fibroblasts/telocytes. In gut: a fibrous network in the submucosa and lamina propria, thin streaks between the muscle layers, vessel outlines. Epithelium negative. Common in the stroma.
observed: A: dense yellow fibrous network fills the submucosa in both sections, with thin radial streaks through the muscularis; epithelium/mucosa dark. B, C: mucosal fields with sparse dots. D: bright wavy membranous strands. E: CD34 lies along some CD31 vessels (white), some partner-negative.
why: The stain follows the stromal compartment as a fibrous network, avoids the epithelium, and partly co-localises with CD31 vessels, as a CD34 stain should.
